title: Weak duality: flow value is bounded by cut capacity
statement:
Let $N$ be a network with disjoint nonempty source set $X$ and sink set $Y$, distinguished source $x$ and sink $y$, and integer capacity function $c$. Let $f$ be a flow in $N$, and let $(S,\bar S)$ be a cut, so that $x\in S$ and $y\notin S$. Then the value of $f$ is at most the capacity of the cut:
\[
\mathrm{val}(f)\;\le\;\operatorname{cap}(S,\bar S)\;=\;\sum_{u\in S}\sum_{v\notin S} c(u,v).
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a flow in N (capacity constraint and conservation at intermediate vertices)
S determines a cut: x in S and y not in S
N is a network with disjoint nonempty source set X and sink set Y and nonnegative integer capacities
replaced:
\emph{For any flow \texttt{f} and any cut \texttt{K = (S, $\bar{S}$)} in \texttt{N},
\texttt{val f $\le$ cap K}.}
